This local UMD bundle supplies both static and dynamically selected desktop
icons through the existing lucide.createIcons API. No runtime CDN request or
fallback is used. Electron packaging already includes desktop/renderer/**/*.
Keep LICENSE and this provenance record with the bundle when updating it.
